mt_runtime_observations.timing_limit: Some Node validation shared CPU briefly; these are raw observations, not isolated or comparative performance benchmarks.

mt_interpretation: Natural translation handles the selected Rust condition; fixed-format B/C weakens it. Readonly full English context D repairs that condition while introducing duplicated information in other cases. This supports further input/protocol work, not activation of C/D or a conclusion that base-model capacity is generally insufficient. Structural acceptance is not semantic accuracy.

next_steps: Evaluate input/ownership protocols on independent unseen paragraphs and conditions/negations.
If protocol failures persist, build a separate, reviewed format-adaptation curriculum; keep these diagnostic cases out of optimizer inputs.
Require paired current-model/candidate validation of structure, condition/negation, label ownership and omissions before training promotion.

limitations: Small Bergamot still mistranslates software library and Properties. Remaining 144 Python roots include empty/moved slots, missing fixed content and brackets; they are retained.
MT tests use real native CPU generation and production decoder/renderer replay, not a new complete Firefox+wllama model lifecycle test.
Semantic review is by the assistant on eight previously used cases; no independent blind accuracy claim.
No new GPU training, checkpoint conversion, model upload, default-engine switch or official Microsoft/Google calls.
